description: Delete one file from the artist's Library for good, with its stored file. Ask the artist first and name the file: it cannot be brought back. Refused while the file is in use (a song's or album's cover, the logo, the profile photo, an Artist page photo, or any Promo post: draft, approved, scheduled or posted); the refusal names each use and post, so the artist can change those first.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

name: delete_media
title: Delete a Library file
